Why Simpliers?

The #1 Instagram Giveaway Picker

Really All Comments

Unlike other giveaway sites that only fetch the last 150 comments, we collect ALL comments on your post. No participant is left behind, even on posts with thousands of comments.

Transparent & Verifiable Results

We display the complete list of participants on the results page. Your followers can verify the fairness of the draw, increasing trust in your account.

Secure Data Storage

All your giveaway data (comments, likes, retweets) is stored in our secure databases for at least 15 days. You can always prove the legitimacy of your results.

Most Trusted Giveaway Platform

Simpliers is the world's most widely used paid giveaway picker. With a clear revenue model and secure payment processing, your transactions are protected.

AI-Powered Rules

Simpliers can analyze your Instagram post and automatically fill in your giveaway rules using AI. It detects requirements like mentions, hashtags, and participation conditions directly from your post caption, saving you time and reducing errors.

Verifiable Validity Certificate

When your giveaway ends, Simpliers generates a unique validity certificate you can share with your followers. Anyone can verify the results using the giveaway code, ensuring complete transparency and trust in the outcome.

Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to the most common questions

Why should I do an Instagram Giveaway?

You can increase the engagement of your Instagram followers and boost likes and comments on your Instagram posts. By doing Instagram giveaway contests, grow your target audience.

Can I run a giveaway without an account?

Yes. Just paste your post link and you can easily run your giveaway even without an account.

What is Instagram Giveaway with Artificial Intelligence?

When you do your giveaway with your post on Instagram, Simpliers With Artificial Intelligence, it can automatically fill in the rules of your giveaway and come up with a funny name for your giveaway's results page. Simpliers Be sure to try the AI feature.

Is Simpliers safe?

Instagram Giveaways on Simpliers are completely safe. The winners are selected on the end user screen, regardless of the server. Due to the system design, it is not possible for anyone, including simpliers personnel, to manipulate or predict the giveaway results.

So giveaway prizes are safe.

Is it free to run an Instagram giveaway with Simpliers?

Your first Instagram giveaway is free for posts with up to 200 comments. See pricing for additional giveaways or posts above that limit.

Can I run a giveaway with Instagram Reels and carousels?

Yes, Simpliers works with all Instagram post types: photos, carousels, videos, and Reels. Simply copy the link of any post and paste it into the giveaway tool. Simpliers will automatically collect all comments regardless of the content type.

How can I ensure my Instagram giveaway is fair and transparent?

Simpliers ensures your giveaway transparency in several ways:
- Collects ALL comments directly from Instagram's servers, not just the last 150 like other tools.
- Winners are selected on the user's screen, independent of the server, making any manipulation impossible.
- A verifiable validity certificate is generated that you can share with your followers.
- The entire comment collection process is displayed in real time on screen.
These measures make Simpliers the most trusted Instagram giveaway platform.

Does Simpliers work with private Instagram accounts?

No, for Simpliers to collect comments from a post, the Instagram account must be public. If your account is private, comments are not accessible from Instagram's servers. We recommend switching your account to public before starting the giveaway, and you can set it back to private after it's finished.

How many winners can I pick in an Instagram giveaway?

With Simpliers, you can pick as many winners as you want in your Instagram giveaway. You can also set up alternate winners to replace those who don't meet the rules or don't claim their prize. Additionally, you can set participation rules like required mentions, duplicate comment filtering, and fair participation limits per user.

How to Run an Instagram Giveaway?

Running an Instagram giveaway with simpliers is easy. Follow the steps below to create a professional and fair giveaway in minutes.

1 Step 1

Copy Your Giveaway Post Link

Copy the link of your Instagram giveaway post.

  • Click the three-dot menu at the top of the post
  • Select "Copy link"
2 Step 2

Paste the Link and Continue

Paste the link you copied and proceed to the Rules page.

To run a giveaway with multiple posts, you can add more posts using the Add Another Post button.
3 Step 3

Set Giveaway Settings and Rules

Give your giveaway a name, set the winner count and substitute count.
You can set your rules in this step if you have any.

Available Rules:

Minimum Tag Count Word Filter Count Everyone Once Fair Participation Limit Only on simpliers
Advanced Rules
These rules will be checked after winners are selected. You can also set these rules on your Giveaway Page.
Follow Check Minimum Post Count Minimum Follower Count
Use the Fill Rules with AI button to have your rules automatically detected by Artificial Intelligence.
4 Step 4

Wait for All Comments to Be Retrieved

Unlike other giveaway tools, simpliers retrieves all comments completely and runs a real giveaway. This ensures your results are truly fair and your brand's trust is maintained.

Why do we wait? Instagram delivers comments in a paginated format, making it impossible to access thousands of comments or likes at once. Just like how modern apps load data as you scroll.
Simpliers retrieves all comments completely, even if you have millions. The duration varies depending on the number of comments for a fair giveaway.

Once complete, you'll be redirected to your personalized Giveaway Page.

5 Step 5

Start the Giveaway and Pick Winners

Set a Countdown Timer and click the "Start Giveaway" button to start your giveaway.
During the countdown, all participants will be shuffled on screen, and winners will be selected when the timer ends.

You can start a live stream on this page to show your followers the transparency of the giveaway.
Before starting the giveaway, click "View Participants" to review all participants, usernames, and comment contents in detail.
6 Step 6

Share the Results

Share your giveaway results page and certificate with your followers. Increase trust in your brand by showing that your results are reliable.

  • Download and share the certificate in Instagram Story format
  • Share the results page link with your followers
  • Share your giveaway code so followers can verify the results.
Transparency builds trust. Your followers can verify that your giveaway was fair and will participate in your future giveaways with more confidence.
